rationale: COHR is trading at 99.9% of its intraday range, essentially at the session high after a massive gap-up (~13.4% from prior close) with no news catalyst visible. At this extreme position with price already extended well above VWAP ($211.11) and the 9-EMA ($214.26), chasing long carries significant mean-reversion risk, while shorting into a strong momentum move with no clear exhaustion signal (price just made a new high on the last candle) is equally dangerous. The risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable given the lack of a defined structural level to lean against.
